title: Content Item Metadata
description: Schema for YAML frontmatter embedded in artistic research content HTML files. Parsed at build time by gray-matter. Cross-file constraints (exactly one conclusion per topic, conclusion date must be newest in its topic) are enforced by the Vite build plugin, not by this schema.

title.description: Human-readable title of the content item. Displayed on the card and in the table of contents.

date.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime of when this event/entry occurred (e.g. 2025-03-14 or 2025-03-14T15:30:00). Used for timeline placement and to validate that conclusion items are the newest in their topic. If set to midnight (e.g. 2025-03-14T00:00:00) it is considered a date without a time component.

topic.description: Topic of the artistic research. This determines which cluster an item belongs to in Topic view. Use 'general' for the _abstract.html item.

category.description: Category label used in the filter UI and displayed on the card in timeline view (e.g. 'Field Recording', 'Studio Work'). Not required for the _abstract.html item.

type.description: Visual and semantic type of the card. Every non-'normal' type renders with a white label box straddling the card's top border. 'introduction' reads 'Introduction' and, if present, must be the OLDEST item in its topic (enforced at build time). 'conclusion' reads 'Conclusion'; exactly one per topic is required and it must be the newest in its topic (enforced at build time). 'imponderable' reads 'Loose Ends & Unsolved Problems'. 'reflection' reads 'Reflection'. 'lookout' reads 'Lookout & Future Prospects'. 'abstract' reads 'Abstract' and uses a dark surface. NOTE: 'default' here is a JSON Schema annotation used by editors and tooling — it is not enforced by validation.

width.description: Box width multiplier for text box (default: 1.0). Controls line-break behaviour and the width/height ratio without affecting font size. Has no effect on media items (aspect ratios are preserved via the sidecars list).

font_size.description: Font size multiplier relative to the global baseline, for text/HTML items only. Separate from 'size' so font scale and area can be tuned independently. Omit to use the default of 1.0.

author.description: Author name (used on the abstract/cover page).

year.description: Year of publication (used on the abstract/cover page).

institution.description: Institution and/or faculty name (used on the abstract/cover page).

summary.description: Short summary or subtitle (used on the abstract/cover page).

sidecars.description: Ordered list of media files attached to this item. Each filename must be prefixed with the stem of the parent HTML file (e.g. for 'my-item.html' → 'my-item--clip.mp4').

filename.description: Filename (not path) of the media file located in the same content folder. Must be prefixed with the stem of the parent HTML file.

kind.description: Media type. Determines the player/renderer used. 'text' sidecars are additional HTML/MD files rendered as separate cards without title or metadata.

description.description: Short caption shown beneath or alongside the media file. Optional.

size.description: Size multiplier for this media file relative to the global baseline for its kind. Aspect ratio is always preserved; this scales the rendered area. Omit to use the default of 1.0.
